sample_unit: patient information documents (6 laryngology conditions x 3 sources)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRE) of LLM-generated patient information versus ENT UK
links.effect: ENT UK FRE 64.6 and FKGL 7.4; ChatGPT FRE 38.8, FKGL 11.0; Gemini FRE 38.3, FKGL 11.9 (all p<0.001).
links.quote: ENT UK showed the highest readability (FRE: 64.6 ± 8.4) and lowest grade level (FKGL: 7.4 ± 1.5), significantly better than that of ChatGPT (FRE: 38.8 ± 10.5, FKGL: 11.0 ± 1.5) and Gemini (FRE: 38.3 ± 8.5, FKGL: 11.9 ± 1.2) (all p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated patient materials relative to recommended literacy standards
links.effect: ChatGPT FKGL 11.0 and Gemini FKGL 11.9 versus ENT UK 7.4; AI text requires higher reading levels and falls short of recommended literacy standards.
links.quote: GPT and Gemini produce patient information of comparable quality and engagement to ENT UK but require higher reading levels and fall short of recommended literacy standards.

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability, quality, and actionability of patient education materials generated by LLMs compared to ENT UK professional guidelines without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
